mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ (ID_, PROC_INST_ID_, TASK_ID_, PROC_DEF_KEY_, TASK_DEF_KEY_, TITLE_, ASSIGNEE_ID_, SENDER_ID_, INSTRUCTION_, DEADLINE_, HANDLE_STATUS_, HANDLE_RESULT_, HANDLE_TIME_, IS_REVOKED_, REVOKE_TIME_, REVOKE_REASON_, CREATE_TIME_, UPDATE_TIME_) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{processInstanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{processDefinitionKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskDefinitionKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assigneeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{senderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instruction, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{deadline, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{handleStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{handleResult, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{handleTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{revoked, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{revokeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{revokeReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ SET HANDLE_STATUS_ = #{handleStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HANDLE_RESULT_ = #{handleResult, jdbcType=CLOB}, HANDLE_TIME_ = #{handleTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, IS_REVOKED_ = #{revoked, jdbcType=INTEGER}, REVOKE_TIME_ = #{revokeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, REVOKE_REASON_ = #{revokeReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME_ = #{updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE ID_ = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ WHERE ID_ = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ WHERE ID_ = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT * FROM BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ WHERE ASSIGNEE_ID_ = #{assigneeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_REVOKED_ = 0 AND HANDLE_STATUS_ <> 'DONE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATE_TIME_ DESC, ID_ DESC
SELECT * FROM BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ WHERE SENDER_ID_ = #{senderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_REVOKED_ = 0 AND HANDLE_STATUS_ <> 'DONE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATE_TIME_ DESC, ID_ DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ WHERE ASSIGNEE_ID_ = #{assigneeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HANDLE_STATUS_ <> 'DONE' AND IS_REVOKED_ = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ SET HANDLE_STATUS_ = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HANDLE_RESULT_ = #{handleResult, jdbcType=CLOB}, HANDLE_TIME_ = #{handleTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATE_TIME_ = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID_ = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ SET IS_REVOKED_ = 1, REVOKE_TIME_ = #{revokeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, REVOKE_REASON_ = 'INVALID', UPDATE_TIME_ = #{revokeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = #{processInstanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HANDLE_STATUS_ <> 'DONE' AND IS_REVOKED_ = 0

UPDATE BIZ_HANDLE_RECORD_ SET HANDLE_STATUS_ = 'OVERDUE', UPDATE_TIME_ = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DEADLINE_ IS NOT NULL AND DEADLINE_ < #{now, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND HANDLE_STATUS_ IN ('PENDING', 'HANDLING') AND IS_REVOKED_ = 0
